meta.source: Omarchy colors.toml (derived by design/build_tokens.py) + EchoFiles brand

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main file area and window ground. Omarchy `background`.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, preview pane and inactive dual-pane side. Omarchy `dark_background`.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Tab strip, status bar and text-field wells. Omarchy `darker_background`.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, command palette. Omarchy `lighter_background` (light themes: background lifted toward white).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row separators, pane dividers, section rules. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (fields, buttons, checkboxes) and resize handles. At least 3:1 on bg, bg-sunken and bg-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Filenames and all primary text, on every surface and on selection. At least 7:1.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, the focused filename, dialog titles. Omarchy `bright_foreground`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata columns (size, date, kind), captions, sidebar section labels, placeholder text. At least 4.5:1 on every surface and on selection.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only. Omarchy `dark_foreground`; not guaranteed legible.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one active thing: primary button fill, active tab underline, drag target outline, progress fill. Omarchy `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or glyph (links, active sidebar item label, sort-direction arrow), on every surface and selection.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: drop-target folder, current-location chip.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected rows and tiles. Omarchy `selection`; ink stays 7:1 on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard cursor and focus outline (1px inset on rows, 2px outline on controls). At least 3:1 on every surface and selection.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover layer: foreground at 8% (Omarchy controls hover-cursor-fill-alpha).

tokens.name: state-press
tokens.usage: Pressed layer: foreground at 22% (Omarchy pressed-fill-alpha).

tokens.name: state-active
tokens.usage: Active/checked layer: foreground at 18% (Omarchy selected-fill-alpha).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the command palette. Omarchy scrim-alpha 0.5 over darker_background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed transfer, mounted state, verified checksum. Omarchy `green`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success banners and pills.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success as text or glyph on bg, bg-raised or success-soft.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Read-only / dirty-volume / Fast Startup state. Omarchy `yellow`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning banners and pills.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning as text or glyph on bg, bg-raised or warning-soft.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Permanent delete, failed operation, broken link. Omarchy `red`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error banners and pills.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger as text or glyph on bg, bg-raised or danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (Delete permanently button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: cloud-only placeholder, +ADS stream, hint banners. Omarchy `cyan`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info banners and pills.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info as text or glyph on bg, bg-raised or info-soft.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text on an info fill.

tokens.name: world-linux
tokens.usage: Linux section mark and Linux drive usage bars. Omarchy `orange`; 3:1 on the sidebar.

tokens.name: world-windows
tokens.usage: Windows section mark and NTFS drive usage bars. Omarchy `blue`; 3:1 on the sidebar.

tokens.name: world-phone
tokens.usage: Phone section mark (v0.3+). Omarchy `green`; 3:1 on the sidebar.

tokens.name: world-network
tokens.usage: Network section mark and network places (SMB, SFTP, FTP). Omarchy `magenta`; 3:1 on the sidebar.

tokens.name: icon-folder
tokens.usage: Folder front face in colour icons. Omarchy `yellow`.

tokens.name: icon-folder-back
tokens.usage: Folder back sheet and tab.

tokens.name: icon-folder-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph printed on a folder (download arrow, lock, gear…).

tokens.name: icon-blue
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {blue}: documents, cloud, phone, home. Omarchy `blue`.

tokens.name: icon-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {blue-deep}: document fold, depth faces.

tokens.name: icon-green
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {green}: spreadsheets, images, sync, shield. Omarchy `green`.

tokens.name: icon-red
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {red}: PDF, video, full trash. Omarchy `red`.

tokens.name: icon-orange
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {orange}: slides, star, alert. Omarchy `orange`.

tokens.name: icon-purple
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {purple}: code, audio, vector, lock. Omarchy `magenta`.

tokens.name: icon-yellow
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {yellow}: SD-card contacts.

tokens.name: icon-slate
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {slate}: drives, config, neutral glyphs on paper.

tokens.name: icon-slate-deep
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {slate-deep}: drive bases, terminal, script files.

tokens.name: icon-paper
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {paper}: plain document page.

tokens.name: icon-paper-fold
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {paper-fold}: page corner fold, placeholder lines.

tokens.name: icon-on
tokens.usage: Colour-icon slot {on}: glyphs printed on coloured fills.

tokens.name: brand-ember
tokens.usage: Logo back sheet. Brand surfaces only (About, onboarding, app icon) — never UI state.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Logo middle sheet. Brand surfaces only.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Logo front sheet. Brand surfaces only.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo tile ground. Brand surfaces only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the About screen. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, preview-pane filename, drive name in Properties.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Filenames, menu items, buttons, fields. The default. Omarchy font base-size + 1.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Active sidebar item, focused filename, emphasised values.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Size / date / kind columns, status bar, tile subtitles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar section headers and column headers. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudge, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control between icon and label; tile grid inner inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding in compact density; menu item inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between sibling controls; row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toolbar and sidebar padding; gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog and pane padding; toast padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dialog sections; empty-state stack.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state and About screen outer spacing.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Window, panes, tabs, and every floating surface (menus, dialogs, toasts, palette, tooltips) — follows Hyprland `rounding` (Omarchy default 0).

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Rows, selection, menu items, pills, key hints, checkboxes, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, grid tiles.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Thumbnails and image previews only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb, status dots only.

shadow.note: Omarchy is flat: borders separate, shadows only lift what floats.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, drag ghost.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, toasts.

size.note: Fixed geometry the virtualised list depends on. Rows never change height at runtime.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: List row, compact density.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: List row, default density; menu item; sidebar item.

tokens.name: row-comfy
tokens.usage: List row, comfortable density.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Button, field, segmented control height.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Toolbar height.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab strip height.

tokens.name: statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar default width (resizable 180–360).

tokens.name: icon-glyph
tokens.usage: UI glyphs in toolbar, menus, rows.

tokens.name: icon-row
tokens.usage: Colour file icon in list rows.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Colour icon in grid tiles.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Grid tile width (icon 48 or thumbnail 88).

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Thumbnail box inside a tile; decoded from the 128px freedesktop cache.

duration.note: Animations never delay input and are interruptible. prefers-reduced-motion (and Omarchy animations off) sets every duration to 0.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Keyboard cursor moves, selection changes, sort, typing.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press layers, checkbox tick, icon swaps.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, popovers, pane toggles.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, command palette, preview pane slide.

tokens.name: dur-ambient
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer and indeterminate progress sweep (one loop).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Anything entering or changing size.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving; runs at 70% of the enter duration.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Toast arrival and drop-target pop only.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Progress and shimmer.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Column header, sticky breadcrumb.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Context menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and unavailable menu items.

tokens.name: opacity-hidden-file
tokens.usage: Dotfiles and Windows Hidden/System files when shown.

tokens.name: opacity-cut
tokens.usage: Items on the clipboard after Cut.
